messages:
Maria Chen: Uploaded the 'Shadowline' dark theme Figma file. Main asks: editor token legibility, multi-series chart palette, and table/grid row contrast. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/shadowline-theme
Lena Park: First glance looks slick. Two quick things: keywords vs types are too close in hue; legends on small charts feel cramped.
Omar Ruiz: Agreed on tokens. Proposal (editor): keyword = #61A9FF, type/identifier = #C8F0FF (lower saturation), string = #9EE6A6, function = #FFD58A, comment = #7C838A. Should separate warm vs cool.
Priya Singh: For charts we need colorblind-safe + good grayscale separation. My draft 6-col palette: #FF7660 (coral), #4BC0C8 (teal), #6F63FF (indigo), #FFCF66 (amber), #BFA3FF (lavender), #2E9E5E (forest). Legends at 12px weight 500.
DesignBot: Contrast scan: header (15px/600) = 4.8:1, body (13px/400) = 4.1:1, inline code = 3.6:1. Chart legend labels at 12px/500 = 4.3:1. Recommendation: bump body to #E8F1F9 or use 13px/500.
Maria Chen: Prefer changing token colors over increasing body lightness. Tokens are the real pain when scanning code. Also let's darken table row dividers to rgba(255,255,255,0.12).
Omar Ruiz: Mock CSS for the editor and code blocks: 
```
/* shadowline editor tokens */
.token.keyword { color: #61A9FF; }
.token.type { color: #C8F0FF; }
.token.string { color: #9EE6A6; }
pre, code { background: rgba(8,10,12,0.66); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04); padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; }
```
Priya Singh: UX nit: hover on chart points currently adds a big halo; can we switch to a 1.5px outline + slight radius to reduce noise? Also legends should show swatch + abbreviated label on narrow widths.
Lena Park: Accessibility suggestion: add a small status chip next to theme toggle showing compliance (AA / WCAG2.1). Helpful for customers and internal QA.
UX-Research: Quick user insight: people expect theme variant names in the menu — call it 'Shadowline (Dark)' rather than generic 'Dark Mode'. Improves discoverability.
Maria Chen: Good calls. Focus ring adjustment? Thinking 2px solid #82BDFE at 55% opacity, no blur.
Omar Ruiz: +1 for solid ring. Also will run palette through colorblind simulators and grayscale to check separability before we lock it.
DesignBot: Re-run queued after edits. Staging preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/theme-preview/shadowline. Tag me when Figma updated. :eyes:
